issues.on_page: Revenue vehicle movement control ... Customer services and promotion (transit operating functions)
issues.issue: No transit category exists, so mapping transit operations to streets/highways is a judgment call. Only disbursements[0] carries a review flag; the other nine lines with the same mapping (35,717,467 together) don't. 'Ticketing and fare collection' and 'Customer services and promotion' could arguably be general government.

Entity-wide depreciation and amortization covers administrative assets as well as transit ones, yet the whole amount is put under streets/highways with no review flag. The category is defensible but not certain.
